4. Google Sheets Sync by @DavidWilliames

This plugin helps you import data directly from Google sheet to Figma.

Get it here: https://t.co/TCKV6C9sCP https://t.co/kikwudLOAX

5. Beautiful Shadows by @alexwidua

This plugin allows you to create beautiful shadows by simply dragging a 'light source' which casts a shadow on selected elements.

Get it here: https://t.co/sVC2JjtGuT https://t.co/6NikGVw9hK
